title: Modeling Uncertainty in Neural Networks with TensorFlow Probability Series
notes:
Series of articles on uncertainty modeling in neural networks, potentially relevant for probabilistic approaches in bandits and RL. Includes: Part 1: An introduction (molak-2021-modeling-uncertainty-neural-networks-3), Part 2: Aleatoric uncertainty (molak-2021-modeling-uncertainty-neural-networks-4), Part 3: Epistemic uncertainty (molak-2021-modeling-uncertainty-neural-networks-5), Part 4: Going fully probabilistic (molak-2021-modeling-uncertainty-neural-networks and molak-2021-modeling-uncertainty-neural-networks-2).
